title: Generate RSS/Atom feed at /feed.xml for blog content distribution
description: Create an RSS/Atom XML feed at /feed.xml that automatically publishes blog posts with metadata (title, description, author, date, link). Enable external readers and aggregators to subscribe to new blog content.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /feed.xml returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with Content-Type: application/rss+xml header
Each <item> includes <title>, <link>, <pubDate>, <description>, and <guid> from published blog posts in reverse chronological order
Feed includes <lastBuildDate> that updates when blog posts change, and <channel> metadata with hostel name and description
technicalNotes: File to create: app/feed.xml/route.ts — RSS route handler using rss package (~80 lines)
File to update: lib/blog.ts — ensure getBlogPosts() returns pubDate, slug, excerpt, and author
Test command: curl http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | xmllint --noout - (validate XML structure)

title: Add JB News & Updates widget to homepage with curated RSS feed integration
description: Create a homepage widget that fetches and displays 3-4 latest items from curated JB tourism, news, and event RSS feeds (e.g., Johor State Tourism, TimeOut KL JB events). Cache results for 6 hours to avoid hitting external feeds too frequently.
acceptanceCriteria: HomeNewsWidget component displays 3-4 recent news items with title, date, source name, and clickable link
RSS feed URLs are configurable in environment variables and validated on page load; invalid URLs are skipped silently
Component falls back gracefully if any feed fetch fails — shows cached data from previous fetch or empty 'No news available' state
technicalNotes: File to create: lib/rss-fetcher.ts — RSS parser using fast-xml-parser package (~100 lines)
File to create: components/HomeNewsWidget.tsx — React component with SWR data fetching (~80 lines)
File to update: app/page.tsx — add <HomeNewsWidget /> to hero section
Test command: npm test components/HomeNewsWidget.test.tsx -v (mock fetch, verify rendering)

title: Create dynamic blog tag pages at /blog/tags/[tag] for long-tail keyword SEO
description: Generate dynamic tag pages at /blog/tags/[tag] that list all blog posts with a specific tag. Extract tags from blog post frontmatter and auto-generate pages with proper breadcrumbs, metadata, and internal linking. Add tag cloud to blog list for navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Tag page at /blog/tags/backpacker displays all posts tagged 'backpacker' with meta description, title, and BreadcrumbList schema
Each blog post frontmatter includes tags array (e.g., tags: ['backpacker', 'budget', 'singapore']); getTags() returns unique list
Blog post cards show clickable tags that link to /blog/tags/[tag]; tag pages show 'Back to Blog' and related tags links
technicalNotes: File to create: app/blog/tags/[tag]/page.tsx — dynamic route with generateStaticParams (~70 lines)
File to update: lib/blog.ts — add getTags() and getPostsByTag(tag: string) functions (~50 lines total)
File to update: components/BlogPostCard.tsx — display and link tags
Test command: npm test lib/blog.test.ts -t 'getPostsByTag' -v (verify post filtering by tag)

title: Generate dynamic Open Graph images for blog posts using Next.js ImageResponse
description: Create dynamic Open Graph images for blog posts using Next.js @vercel/og that display post title, author, publication date, and hostel branding. Improves social media preview appearance and click-through rates on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /blog/[slug]/opengraph-image returns a 1200×630px PNG image with post title, author name, publication date, and hostel logo overlaid
og:image meta tag in blog post page head correctly references /blog/[slug]/opengraph-image; og:image:width=1200 and og:image:height=630
Image generation completes in <1s and can be cached for 1 week (Cache-Control: max-age=604800)
technicalNotes: File to create: app/blog/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx — ImageResponse component (~80 lines)
File to update: app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx — add generateMetadata() with og:image metadata object
Test command: npm run build && curl http://localhost:3000/blog/sample-post/opengraph-image -I (verify Content-Type: image/png)

title: Create /singapore-jobs resource hub with FAQPage schema and job seeker CTAs
description: Build a dedicated /singapore-jobs page targeting Malaysians seeking work in Singapore. Include FAQ section with job visa types (EP, S Pass, Work Permit), accommodation CTAs, and FAQPage JSON-LD schema for Google rich results. Cross-link to /guide and /book pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Page includes FAQPage JSON-LD schema in page head with minimum 8 Q&A pairs about Singapore job visa types, processing timelines, and cost
Page displays 'Book your visa run accommodation' and 'Check our guide' CTAs that link to /book and /guide with utm_source=singapore-jobs
Page has title 'Jobs in Singapore for Malaysians | Pelangi Capsule' and meta description targeting 'Singapore work pass, work permit Malaysia' keywords
technicalNotes: File to create: app/singapore-jobs/page.tsx — Next.js page component with SEO metadata and FAQ section (~120 lines)
File to create: lib/singapore-jobs-faq.ts — export FAQ data structure as const singaporeJobsFAQ: FAQItem[] (~80 lines)
File to update: lib/structured-data.ts — add generateFAQPageSchema(faqs: FAQItem[]) function
Test command: npm test lib/structured-data.test.ts -t 'FAQPage' -v (validate schema.org compliance)
